title: The copies threshold for round 33's net2 on either traffic head, scored with 15 stock controllers on validation links
description: Beside BBRv3 and Westwood, held out of all training, the net2s reading net1 v7's traffic head lost about 0.11 on the test links (exp-traffic-head-test-309), almost all of it from the head's belief in copies: net2 yields to a flow it takes for a copy (exp-traffic-head-decompose-val-313). The head refitted beside the 15 other stock controllers (exp-traffic-head-v7-stock-312) cut that loss to 0.03 in round 29's rules but halved their gain among copies. How readily net2 believes copies is the threshold tq, chosen in exp-traffic-head-threshold-val-308 on validation that had no stock flow but Cubic. This searches it again for round 33's learned net2 at iteration 59 (t 0.7), tq in {0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}, on the head of 306 (net2-r33hn) and of 312 (net2-r33hk), three training seeds each, beside round 29's net2 on its own beliefs (net2-v7) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7), on the validation links at campaign seed 21: the five families, 2 and 4 copies (30 s), and one flow from 0 s of each of the 15 stock controllers other than BBRv3 and Westwood (stock-all, 30 s). BBRv3 and Westwood from 0 s (60 s) are run and reported, and are no part of any choice. Rule, stated before the results: the score is the mean of the five-family mean, the copies-30s score and the stock-all-30 score, over three seeds; the pair (head, tq) with the highest score replaces the tested one (306, 0.3) only if it beats it by more than 0.02 and no seed loses to it; the winner then passes if it gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean and on stock-all, all over three seeds. If it passes, it runs on the test links as the second test run.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); G="$IN/n/traffic_head.pt"; echo "8ad397a52a7f09fc2b2a136f017d0a52b49a5f0bfcae9f10040d8a015891f2e8  $G" | sha256sum -c; K="$IN/k/traffic_head.pt"; echo "0480ff07899e8e8286e87fdcf02fcedb43c64aac53a09a4b3363e35b21e78092  $K" | sha256sum -c; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; P+=(--policy "net2-v7-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-v7-s$s.onnx"); r="$IN/r/ppo-r33-s$s"; for h in n k; do e="$OUT/runs/r33$h-s$s"; mkdir -p "$e"; cp "$r/net1.pt" "$r/ppo_spec.json" "$e/"; cp "$r/iter059/actor.pt" "$e/actor.pt"; f="$G"; [ "$h" = k ] && f="$K"; cp "$f" "$e/traffic_head.pt"; for q in 3 5 7 9; do a="net2-r33h$h-q$q-s$s"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "$a" "$e" --t 0.7 --tq "0.$q" --traffic "$f"; P+=(--policy "$a=$OUT/p/$a.onnx"); done; done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 56 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; for f in stock-all:30 held-competitors:60; do n=${f%:*}; d=${f#*:}; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-$n-$d" --split val --family "$n" --duration-ms "${d}000" --seed 21 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-$n-$d/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-$n-$d"; done; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s stock-all-30
